turns.assessment: The simultaneous ~63–65 ps DGD rise on many coherent receivers at t=606, preceded by widespread OTU degradation/loss and protection switching at t=600–602.5, is direct evidence of a common fibre PMD event. Optical power, OSNR, amplifier powers, and pump currents remained unchanged, strongly excluding cuts, connector faults, and amplifier failures. The affected receive direction, including S21-to-S08 traffic, points to the S21-originating fibre; the aerial span E23 is the strongly favored stressed segment.

proposals.rationale: E23 is the aerial fibre span in the implicated S21->S06 direction. A DGD rise exactly matches the large simultaneous DGD changes and BER/LOF effects without optical-power or OSNR changes.
Another span in the same direction could contribute the end-to-end DGD increase, but it lacks the aerial/stress clue.
